rdfs:label: Update
rdfs:comment: An activity in which the actor has updated the object.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Activity`. The wire-level signal that an actor edited an existing object. AS2 leaves processing undefined: in ActivityPub server-to-server delivery, the `object` carries the complete new representation and receivers replace their copy; in client-to-server, Update is a partial merge. Set `as:updated` on the object to record when it changed (the activity's `published` is when the Update was issued).

history.note: Notes: S2S vs C2S semantics, use as:updated on the object rather than as:published; added urn:solid:updated to seeAlso.
